## Where

Which file and section (`README.md`, `deploy/USAGE.md`, `deploy/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`,
`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `deploy/config.example.yaml`, etc.), with a line number or
heading if you have one.

## Problem

What's missing, unclear, or wrong? If it's drift — the doc says one thing and the
code (`src/*.rs`) does another — quote both sides; that's the single most useful
thing you can include here, since it's what makes the fix verifiable rather than a
guess.

## Suggested fix (optional)

What the doc should say instead, if you already know.
